scope: Twelve emitters measured by agent A, selected exactly by anchors-assisted-a.json; the other thirteen C emitters are outside this review.
method: Read actual raw and marked grids visually, then independently validate all96 native PNG RGBA probes, SHA values, retained source images/rows/columns/frame geometry and exact marker overlays. Marked grids were reproduced in memory byte-for-byte from measured points and original grids. All96 points equal the final live anchor registry. No production file or point was edited.
